dedupe_keys.name: repository of reference building models of multi residential plus energy buildings

description: Eurac Research publishes executable TRNSYS models for low-rise and high-rise multi-residential Plus Energy Buildings. The November 2023 Cultural-E ZIP download represents four climatic and cultural geoclusters and allows changes to building-envelope, HVAC and weather inputs. It includes centralised HVAC and decentralised compact heat-pump configurations covering heating, cooling, dehumidification and hot water. The models were developed with TRNSYS 18.02 and exported so users do not need a TRNSYS licence to run them. Access is free under CC BY-ND 4.0; changing model inputs should not be confused with permission to redistribute modified software. The executables can support building-energy simulations and technology comparisons. Operating-system requirements, numerical error and executable portability remain unknown from the public summary. Related catalogue record platform-trnsys covers the simulation platform, not these archetypes. No executable was downloaded or run.
